name: Chatbot Arena
description: Chatbot Arena is a crowdsourced LLM evaluation platform where users submit prompts and blind pairwise comparisons between model outputs, with Elo scores dynamically adjusted based on human preference votes. It serves as a live, continuously updated ranking system for LLMs across open-ended tasks, with human preference as the ultimate arbiter of quality. The platform functions as a dynamic benchmark where rankings evolve as new models are added and new user interactions occur.
reputation: Highly influential; widely used as a real-world human preference leaderboard; considered a gold standard for open-ended LLM comparison by the research community.
notes: Rankings are dynamic and continuously updated as new votes arrive. Not reproducible in the traditional sense—results depend on the crowd of users. Subject to prompt distribution shifts over time. Human preference does not always align with factual correctness.
